failure_summary: Initial HTTP tests reached the old JSON body parser; valid upload and rejection cases failed. Two fixture reservations initially named limit instead of the existing byte_limit property; corrected without changing the capacity assertion.

CLI and startup red runs lacked the new entrypoints. New startup fixture initially omitted required tokenizer identity metadata and called render/encode with the wrong signature; corrected to the existing contracts.
An intermediate focused command omitted the already installed pinned llguidance PYTHONPATH, causing nine grammar setup errors. Final broad and focused execution use the established dependency path.

First GPU attempt initialized and stopped its server cleanly before inference. The new probe incorrectly expected namespace receipts on stdout; existing nonstreaming CLI receipts are on stderr. Probe now explicitly parses that existing format; CLI semantics were not changed to fit it.

Initial evidence collector mistakenly expected nine CLI subprocesses. The recorded workflow has eight; corrected collector asserts their exact ordered command sequence without rerunning or changing measurement data.
